about: Records for the unit 12 replay checks. Genuine records are sessions of the course's own clients played through public/runtime.mjs and recorded by a correct recorder; each must replay to its final. Each tampered record is a copy of the skilled record with one change, and must be refused with its reason. A tampered record's "what" says what was changed.

genuine.name: skilled
genuine.about: the honest skilled player, server seed 1201, its own network (30 ms one way + 0..10 ms jitter): every input admitted, 12 shots

genuine.name: expert
genuine.about: the honest expert player, server seed 1212, its own network: two inputs applied in the same tick, 3 hits

genuine.name: reconnects
genuine.about: the honest skilled player on a connection that drops out (the reconnects model), server seed 1323: round 2 timed out with no shot, and an input lost in an outage leaves a gap in the seqs

genuine.name: jitter
genuine.about: the honest skilled player on a jittery connection (the jitter model), server seed 120229: one input was overtaken by the next and refused as stale, so the seqs skip it

tampered.name: second-fire
tampered.what: a second fire added at tick 1836, 5 ticks after round 12's shell landed (same angle and power, the next seq); its final was recomputed as if the server had applied it (shots 12 -> 13), so only re-checking each input with admit catches it (refused: fired)

tampered.name: fire-while-flying
tampered.what: a fire added at tick 723, while round 6's shell is in the air (later seqs and n moved up by one). The game ignores a fire while the shell flies, so final is unchanged: only admit catches it (refused: flying)

tampered.name: edited-power
tampered.what: the last input's power changed from 60 to 65 (n 102, a fire); final left as recorded. Replayed, the game ends with power 65, not 60, and the same score

tampered.name: wrong-score
tampered.what: final.score changed from 0 to 1

tampered.name: removed-input
tampered.what: input n 40 removed, so n jumps from 39 to 41

tampered.name: swapped-ticks
tampered.what: the ticks of inputs n 20 and n 21 swapped (323 and 328 become 328 and 323), so a tick goes down

tampered.name: tick-at-end
tampered.what: the last input's tick changed from 1790 to 1851, the record's end

tampered.name: seq-repeated
tampered.what: input n 30 given the seq of input n 29 (30 becomes 29), so seq does not go up

tampered.name: n-from-zero
tampered.what: n numbered 0, 1, 2, ... instead of 1, 2, 3, ...

tampered.name: power-150
tampered.what: input n 10's power changed from 76 to 150 (parseInput refuses it: power)

tampered.name: extra-key
tampered.what: an extra top-level field: "note": "trust me"

tampered.name: version-2
tampered.what: v changed from 1 to 2

tampered.name: mode-1
tampered.what: mode changed from 9 to 1

tampered.name: missing-end
tampered.what: the field end removed

tampered.name: seed-text
tampered.what: seed written as text ("2087238265") instead of a number

tampered.name: input-extra-key
tampered.what: an extra field in input n 15: "hit": true

tampered.name: input-missing-fire
tampered.what: the field fire removed from input n 21

tampered.name: final-extra-key
tampered.what: an extra field in final: "hits": 0

tampered.name: seed-negative
tampered.what: seed changed from 2087238265 to -1, below 0

tampered.name: seed-too-big
tampered.what: seed changed from 2087238265 to 4294967296, one above the largest seed, 4,294,967,295

tampered.name: tick-negative
tampered.what: the first input's tick changed from 26 to -1, so the ticks still never go down
